info.title: shepherdwatch API
info.description: Shepherdwatch V2 – Financial & HR Management API

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of the authenticated user's active sessions.
Each session includes device, browser, OS, IP address, and location info
captured at login time. Use this to show users where they are logged in.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

post.description:
Deactivates all active sessions for the authenticated user.
Optionally pass `currentSessionId` to keep the current session active
so the user is not logged out of their current device.
This is the "Log out of all other devices" feature.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

currentSessionId.description: ID of the session to keep active (current device).

get.description:
Fetches a single active session by its ID. Results are cached.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

patch.description:
Deactivates a specific session by ID. Use this to log out a single
device remotely. The session is soft-deleted (isActive set to false),
not permanently removed—the TTL index handles cleanup after expiry.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

post.description:
Creates a new asset classification. Asset classes define default
depreciation method, useful life, and residual value percentage which
are inherited by assets assigned to this class.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

description.example: Church buses, cars, and other vehicles

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of asset classes.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

Returns a single asset class by ID.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

patch.description:
Updates name, description, or default depreciation settings for an asset class.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

delete.description:
Permanently removes an asset class. Cannot delete if any assets are
still assigned to this class.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

400.description: Cannot delete — assets are still assigned.

post.description: Accountant submits a request to sell a fixed asset. The request goes to pending status.

400.description: Invalid input or asset already sold.

get.summary: Get asset sales log by ID

patch.description: Financial Director approves the sale, disposing the asset and posting the credit ledger journal.

post.description:
Registers a new fixed asset. The asset is created with `active` status.
Depreciation is calculated automatically based on the asset's
depreciation method, useful life, and purchase cost. Assign an asset
class via `assetClassId` to inherit default depreciation settings.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of assets. Filter by branch, asset class, status, or search by name.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

post.description:
Triggers depreciation calculation for all active assets, or for assets
in a specific branch if `branchId` is provided as a query parameter.
This updates each asset's accumulated depreciation and current book value.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant

parameters.name: branchId
parameters.description: Optional branch ID to limit depreciation run.

get.description:
Returns an overview of the asset portfolio including total valuation
(cost and net book value), accumulated depreciation, status counts
(active, disposed, written-off), a category breakdown, and recent
activity. Optionally filter by branch.

This endpoint powers the Asset Management Overview dashboard.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

Returns a detailed depreciation analysis for a given fiscal year.
Includes a category-wise breakdown showing cost, opening net book
value, annual depreciation, and closing net book value for each
asset class. Also provides a monthly depreciation distribution.

This endpoint powers the Depreciation Schedule & Analysis page.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

parameters.name: fiscalYear
parameters.description: Fiscal year for analysis. Defaults to current year.

get.summary: List asset movements across all assets
get.description:
Returns a paginated, populated feed of asset movements across the
organisation. Supports filtering by branch, asset, and date range.

Branch-scoped roles (branch_pastor, accountant, admin, hr, employee)
are automatically restricted to movements involving their own
branch (matched against either `fromBranchId` or `toBranchId`).
Cross-branch roles (super_admin, director, regional_pastor) see
all branches by default and may filter via `branchId`.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

parameters.name: branchId
parameters.description: Filter by source or destination branch.

parameters.name: assetId
parameters.description: Filter to movements for a single asset.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with `-` for descending.

200.description: Paginated movement feed with populated references.

403.description: No branch assigned to your profile.

get.description:
Returns a single asset by ID with populated asset class, branch, photo,
and attachments references. `photo` and `attachments` are expanded to
full FileUpload documents (url, fileName, mimeType, etc.).

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

200.description: Asset details with populated photo and attachments.

patch.description:
Updates an active asset's properties. Disposed or written-off assets cannot be updated.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant

photo.description: FileUpload document ObjectId to use as the asset photo

400.description: Cannot update a disposed or written-off asset.

patch.description:
Marks an asset as disposed. Records the disposal date and amount
(sale price or scrap value). This action is irreversible — the asset
status changes to `disposed` and no further updates are allowed.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant

get.summary: List movements (transfer history) for an asset
get.description:
Returns paginated movement records for the asset, ordered by `movedAt` descending.
Each entry captures `from`/`to` for branch, custodian, and location, plus `handledBy`,
`reason`, and `movedAt`.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

post.description:
Records a movement (transfer) for the asset. At least one `from*`/`to*` pair must be
provided. When `toBranchId`, `toCustodianId`, or `toLocation` is supplied, the asset's
corresponding field is updated.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant

post.summary: Record a stock adjustment for an inventory asset
post.description:
Adjusts on-hand quantity for the asset. `type=increase` adds `delta`, `decrease` subtracts
`delta`, and `recount` sets quantity to the absolute value of `delta`. Cannot result in
a negative quantity.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant

400.description: Validation error or would result in negative quantity.

patch.description:
Replaces the `attachments` array on an asset with the supplied list of
FileUpload document IDs. All supplied IDs must reference existing,
non-deleted `FileUpload` documents or the request is rejected with a
400 error.

This operation is a **full replacement** — any previously attached
files not included in the new list will be removed from the asset
(the underlying FileUpload documents are not deleted).

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ObjectId of the asset to update

fileUploadIds.description:
Array of FileUpload document ObjectIds to attach. Must
contain at least one entry and every ID must belong to
an existing, non-deleted FileUpload document.

400.description:
Validation error, no IDs supplied, or one or more IDs do not
reference a valid non-deleted FileUpload document.

example.message: One or more fileUploadIds are invalid or have been deleted.

403.description: Authenticated user does not have the required role.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of audit log entries. Filter by action type,
user, date range, or search by justification text. Each entry records
who performed an action, what changed (before/after snapshots), and when.
Related: `GET /api/v1/audit-logs/export` for downloading filtered logs.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Filter by audit action type (e.g., settings_updated, transaction_verified)

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Filter by the user who performed the action

get.description:
Exports filtered audit log entries as JSON data for download.
Supports the same filters as the list endpoint. Used by the
Audit Log page "Export" button.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

get.summary: Get a single audit log entry
get.description:
Returns complete details of an audit log entry including before/after
change snapshots and populated user reference.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

post.description:
Creates a new user account with `pending` status and sends an OTP
to the provided email for verification. After registration, call
`POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email` with the OTP code to activate the account.

**Allowed roles:** Public (no auth required)

password.description: Must contain uppercase, lowercase, and a number.

201.description: Registration successful. OTP sent to email.

example.message: Registration successful. Please verify your email.

data.message: Registration successful. Please verify your email.

409.description: An account with this email already exists.

post.description:
Authenticates a user with email and password. Returns access and refresh
tokens. The access token should be included in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
header of subsequent requests. Use `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh-token` when the
access token expires. Invited users must verify their invitation email and
set a password before logging in.

**Allowed roles:** Public (no auth required)

401.description: Invalid credentials, email not verified, or account suspended/deactivated.

post.description:
Verifies a user's email with the 6-digit OTP code sent during registration
or invitation. Upon successful verification the account status changes to
`active`. Invited users may include `newPassword` in this request to set
their first password while verifying the invitation link.

**Allowed roles:** Public (no auth required)

newPassword.description: Required for invited users who do not yet have a password. Must contain uppercase, lowercase, and a number.

post.description:
Resends a new OTP to the user's email. Use this if the previous OTP expired
or was not received. Supports both `email_verification` and `password_reset`
purposes. For email verification flow, call after `POST /api/v1/auth/register`.
For password reset flow, call after `POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password`.

**Allowed roles:** Public (no auth required)

Sends a password reset OTP to the user's email. After receiving the OTP,
call `POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password` with the OTP code and new password.
If the OTP expires, use `POST /api/v1/auth/resend-otp` with `purpose: password_reset`.

**Allowed roles:** Public (no auth required)

example.message: Password reset OTP sent to your email.

post.description:
Resets the user's password using the OTP code received via email.
This is the second step of the forgot-password flow — call after
`POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password`. All active sessions are
invalidated on success.

**Allowed roles:** Public (no auth required)

newPassword.description: Must contain uppercase, lowercase, and a number.

400.description: Invalid or expired OTP, or validation failed.

post.description:
Changes the password of the currently authenticated user.
Requires a valid access token in the `Authorization` header.
The current password must be provided for verification.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

newPassword.description: Must contain uppercase, lowercase, and a number.

400.description: Current password is incorrect or validation failed.

post.description:
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new pair of access and refresh tokens.
The old refresh token is invalidated. Use this endpoint when the access token
from `POST /api/v1/auth/login` expires.

**Allowed roles:** Public (no auth required)

401.description: Invalid or expired refresh token, or session not found.

post.description:
Logs out the authenticated user by invalidating the provided refresh token
and clearing related cached data. Requires a valid access token.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

get.description:
Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.
The response is cached for performance; cache is invalidated on
profile updates, password changes, and email verification.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

patch.description:
Updates the profile of the currently authenticated user. Only `firstName`,
`lastName`, and `phone` can be changed — email and role are immutable via
this endpoint. At least one field must be provided. The user cache is
invalidated on success. Requires a valid access token.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

avatar.description: FileUpload document ID for the user's avatar image.

400.description: Validation failed — at least one field must be provided.

get.description:
Checks whether the given email address is already registered.
Results are cached; cache is automatically cleared when a new user registers.
Useful for real-time form validation on the frontend.

**Allowed roles:** Public (no auth required)

post.description:
Registers a new bank account for a branch. The combination of
`accountNumber` and `bankName` must be unique. Link to a branch
and optionally mark as a domiciliary (foreign currency) account.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant

chartOfAccountId.description: Optional chart-of-account reference for this bank account.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of bank accounts. Filter by branch, currency, or domiciliary status.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

Returns a single bank account by ID with populated branch info.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

patch.description:
Updates fields on an existing bank account.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant
Activates a bank account, allowing it to be used for transactions.
Deactivates a bank account, preventing it from being used for new transactions.

post.description:
Creates a new church branch. New branches start with `onboarding` status.
Assign a lead pastor and an accountant during creation. The branch will
appear on the Branch Management page after creation.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of branches. Filter by status, region, or search
by name. Results include computed compliance scores.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

Returns aggregated counts of branches grouped by status, used by the
Branch Management overview cards on the Director Dashboard.

**Fields returned**
- `total` — total branches in scope.
- `active` — count with `status: 'active'`.
- `onboarding` — count with `status: 'onboarding'`.
- `suspended` — count with `status: 'suspended'`.
- `review` — derived as `total - active - onboarding - suspended`
  (covers any branch in `review` or other transitional states).

**Branch scoping**
- Optional `branchId` query param scopes the summary to a single
  branch (counts will be 0 or 1 per status).
- Branch-scoped roles (`branch_pastor`, `accountant`) have their
  `branchId` auto-injected by the `branchFilter` middleware.
- When omitted by privileged roles, returns network-wide totals.
- Response is cached for 120 seconds per `branchId` (or `'all'`).

**Sample request — network-wide**
```
GET /api/v1/branches/summary
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

**Sample request — single branch**
```
GET /api/v1/branches/summary?branchId=665f1a2b3c4d5e6f70890100
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

parameters.name: branchId
parameters.description: Optional 24-char Mongo ObjectId to scope to a single branch.

get.description:
Returns a single branch with computed compliance score and populated references.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

patch.description:
Updates fields on an existing branch.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

Transitions a branch's status. Valid transitions:
onboarding → active, active → review, active → suspended,
review → active, suspended → active. Only super admins and
directors can change branch status.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

post.description:
Adds a line-item allocation to an existing budget. The budget must be
in `draft` or `revision` status. Allocations specify how much of the
budget is allocated to a particular chart of account.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant, branch_pastor

400.description: Validation failed or budget not in draft/revision status.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of budget allocations. Filter by budget ID or chart of account.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

Returns a single budget allocation by ID with populated budget and chart of account references.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

patch.description:
Updates a budget allocation. The parent budget must be in `draft` or
`revision` status.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant, branch_pastor

400.description: Parent budget is not in draft/revision status.

post.description:
Creates a reusable budget template. Templates contain a title,
description, and a structured set of line items that can be applied
when creating new budgets per branch.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

description.example: Default budget template for all branches

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of budget templates.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

Returns a single budget template by ID with populated line item references.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

patch.description:
Updates an existing budget template's name, description, or line items.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

delete.description:
Permanently removes a budget template. This does not affect budgets already created from this template.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

post.description:
Creates a new budget in `draft` status for a branch and fiscal year.
After creating, add line-item allocations via the Budget Allocations API,
then submit for approval using `PATCH /api/v1/budgets/{id}/submit`.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant, branch_pastor

notes.example: Based on prior year plus 10% growth

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of budgets. Filter by branch, fiscal year, status, or category.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

Returns a high-level budget control dashboard with KPIs (total allocated,
committed, spent, available, utilization rate), a hierarchical breakdown
grouped by category, and monthly utilization data.
Optionally filter by branch and fiscal year (defaults to current year).

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

Returns a single budget by ID with populated branch reference and allocation details.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

patch.description:
Updates fields on a draft or revision budget. Only budgets in `draft`
or `revision` status can be updated.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant, branch_pastor

get.description:
Returns a detailed performance analysis for a single budget, including
overall utilization summary and per-line-item variance analysis.
Each line item shows annual budget, monthly target, expected vs actual
spend YTD, variance, and a status indicator
(over_budget, at_risk, on_track, under_budget).

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

patch.description:
Changes the status of multiple submitted budgets to `approved`, `rejected`, or
`revision` in a single request. Only directors and super admins can execute this.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

Changes a draft budget's status to `submitted`. Once submitted, it
enters the approval queue and can be approved or rejected by a
director or super admin via `PATCH /api/v1/budgets/{id}/approve`.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

400.description: Budget is not in draft status.

patch.description:
Changes a submitted budget's status to `approved`, `rejected`, or
`revision`. Only directors and super admins can approve or reject.
Rejecting requires the status to be set to `rejected`; requesting
changes uses the `revision` status.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

400.description: Budget is not in submitted status.

post.description:
Adds a discussion comment to a budget. Optionally reference a specific
line item (chart of account allocation) for targeted feedback.
Comments are used during the review and approval workflow.

**File attachments workflow:**
1. Upload each file first via `POST /api/v1/files/upload` to get a `FileUpload._id`.
2. Pass those IDs in the `attachments` array of this request body.
3. The response returns each attachment fully populated as
   `{ _id, filename, url, mimetype }` — **not** raw IDs.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

message.example: Please reconsider the office supplies allocation.

lineItemRef.description: Optional `ChartOfAccount._id` to reference a specific budget line item.

attachments.description:
Optional array of `FileUpload._id` values obtained from `POST /api/v1/files/upload`.
The created comment's `attachments` field will be returned as populated objects
with `{ _id, filename, url, mimetype }`.

example.message: Please reconsider the office supplies allocation.

201.description:
Comment created. `attachments` in the response are populated objects
(`{ _id, filename, url, mimetype }`), not raw IDs.

data.message: Please reconsider the office supplies allocation.

400.description: Validation failed (e.g. missing message, invalid ObjectId in attachments).

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of comments for a budget, sorted newest first.
Each comment includes the user details and optional line-item reference.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

parameters.name: budgetId
parameters.description: The budget whose comments to list.

data.message: Please reconsider the office supplies allocation.

delete.description:
Removes a comment from a budget discussion.
A real-time `budget:comment:deleted` event is emitted to all users
who have joined the budget room via Socket.IO.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

parameters.name: budgetId
parameters.description: The budget the comment belongs to.

data.message: Please reconsider the office supplies allocation.

post.summary: Top up a cash box from a bank account
post.description:
Records a manual DEBIT transaction against the source bank account, increments the cash
box asset's `currentBalance`, and links the transaction via `meta.cashBoxAssetId`. The
referenced asset must have `assetType=cash_box`.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant

400.description: Validation error or asset is not a cash box.

post.summary: Create a chart of account entry
post.description:
Creates a new chart of account entry. The COA is hierarchical — entries can
have a `parentId` to form a tree structure. Each account code must be unique
within its branch. Use `GET /api/v1/chart-of-accounts/tree` to view the
full hierarchy.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant

409.description: Account code already exists for this branch.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of chart of account entries. Filter by
`accountType`, `branchId`, or `parentId`. For the full tree view,
use `GET /api/v1/chart-of-accounts/tree`.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

Returns the chart of accounts as a nested tree structure. Optionally
filter by `branchId` to get a single branch's tree.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

get.summary: Get a chart of account entry
get.description:
Returns a single chart of account entry by ID.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

patch.summary: Update a chart of account entry
patch.description:
Updates fields on an existing chart of account entry.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant

delete.summary: Delete a chart of account entry
delete.description:
Soft-deletes (deactivates) a chart of account entry. Only super admins and directors can perform this action.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

Records a new statutory deduction entry (e.g. PAYE, pension, NHF).
Deductions are created with `pending` remittance status. Use

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of statutory deductions. Filter by type, period, branch, or remittance status.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

Returns a detailed compliance dashboard with total liability, available
funds, coverage ratio, breakdown by deduction type, and a 12-month

against outstanding liabilities. Complements the simpler
`GET /api/v1/compliance/summary` with deeper per-type and monthly

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

Returns aggregated compliance metrics — total deductions, remittance
rates, and outstanding amounts by deduction type. Uses the same
query filters as the Dashboard API for consistency.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

Returns a single statutory deduction by ID.

**Allowed roles:** Any authenticated user

patch.description:
Updates an unremitted statutory deduction. Once remitted, deductions are immutable.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, accountant

Marks a statutory deduction as remitted to the relevant authority.
Records the remittance date and the user who confirmed the remittance.
This action is irreversible.

get.description:
Returns high-level financial metrics: total income, total expenses,
net position, pending transactions, and active budget count.
Filter by branch and/or date range.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, regional_pastor, branch_pastor, accountant, admin

Returns monthly income and expense totals over the specified date
range. Useful for rendering trend charts on the frontend.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, regional_pastor, branch_pastor, accountant, admin

Returns budget utilisation metrics — approved amounts vs actual
spend for active budgets. Includes variance analysis per budget.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, regional_pastor, branch_pastor, accountant, admin

Returns aggregated compliance metrics — total statutory deductions,
remittance rates, and outstanding amounts by deduction type.
Also available at `GET /api/v1/compliance/summary`.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, regional_pastor, branch_pastor, accountant, admin

Returns the count and total amount of expense requisitions awaiting
approval, broken down by approval stage (pending_pastor, pending_director).
Useful for supervisors to see how many items need their attention.
Related: `GET /api/v1/requisitions/inbox` for the full list of pending items.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, regional_pastor, branch_pastor, accountant, admin

Returns the last closing balance for all active bank accounts,
along with a combined total. Filter by branch to see branch-specific
accounts. Useful for the treasury overview widget on the dashboard.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, regional_pastor, branch_pastor, accountant, admin

Returns a breakdown of verified expenses grouped by chart-of-account
category and name, with totals and percentage of overall spend.
Useful for rendering pie/donut charts on the dashboard.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, regional_pastor, branch_pastor, accountant, admin

parameters.name: fiscalYear
parameters.description: Filter to a specific fiscal year.

get.description:
Returns a chronological list of upcoming financial events within the
specified date range: pending requisition due dates, scheduled
maintenance tasks, and statutory remittance deadlines. Defaults to
the next 30 days if no date range is provided.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, regional_pastor, branch_pastor, accountant, admin

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start of date range (defaults to today).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End of date range (defaults to 30 days from now).

get.description:
Returns recent transactions sorted by `transactionDate` descending,
with full pagination metadata. Each item includes populated branch,
account, and creator details and is intended for the dashboard
activity feed.

**Pagination**
- `page` (default `1`) — page number, 1-based.
- `limit` (default `10`, max `50`) — page size.

**Branch scoping**
- Branch-scoped roles (`branch_pastor`, `accountant`) have their
  `branchId` auto-injected by the `branchFilter` middleware.
- `super_admin`/`director` may pass an explicit `branchId` or omit
  it to see network-wide activity.

**Sample request**
```
GET /api/v1/dashboard/recent-transactions?branchId=665f1a2b3c4d5e6f70890100&page=1&limit=5
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, regional_pastor, branch_pastor, accountant, admin

parameters.name: branchId
parameters.description: Filter to a specific branch (auto-filled for branch-scoped roles).

get.description:
Aggregates **verified** income transactions for a single branch and
fiscal year into seven fixed donut categories used by the Director
Dashboard chart.

**Categories returned (always all seven, even when zero):**
| Key              | Matched on `account.name` (lowercased contains) |
|------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `tithes`         | `tithe`                                          |
| `offerings`      | `offering`                                       |
| `donations`      | `donat`                                          |
| `special_project`| `special` or `project`                           |
| `missions`       | `mission`                                        |
| `welfare`        | `welfare`                                        |
| `other`          | anything not matched above                       |

**Behaviour**
- Only transactions with `transactionType: 'income'` and
  `status: 'verified'` are counted.
- `branchId` is **required**. Branch-scoped roles have it
  auto-injected from their session.
- `fiscalYear` defaults to the current calendar year.
- Window is `Jan 1 00:00:00` → `Dec 31 23:59:59.999` of the
  fiscal year (server timezone).
- Percentages are rounded to two decimals; any rounding drift is
  absorbed by the last non-zero category so the values sum to 100.
- Response is cached for 120 seconds per `(branchId, fiscalYear)`.

**Sample request**
```
GET /api/v1/dashboard/income-distribution?branchId=665f1a2b3c4d5e6f70890100&fiscalYear=2026
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, regional_pastor, branch_pastor, accountant, admin

parameters.name: branchId

get.summary: Get budget vs actuals for a period (twin-bar chart)
get.description:
Returns the planned budget (scaled allocation) versus actual
**verified** expenses for a single branch, fiscal year, and period.
Powers the twin-bar chart on the Director Dashboard.

**Period semantics**
| Period | Window (in fiscal year)         | Allocation fraction |
|--------|---------------------------------|---------------------|
| `Q1`   | Jan 1 → Mar 31                  | 0.25                |
| `Q2`   | Apr 1 → Jun 30                  | 0.25                |
| `Q3`   | Jul 1 → Sep 30                  | 0.25                |
| `Q4`   | Oct 1 → Dec 31                  | 0.25                |
| `YTD`  | Jan 1 → today (or Dec 31 if past year) | months elapsed / 12 |

**Calculation**
- `budget`  = `sum(BudgetAllocation.amount where Budget.status='approved' and Budget.fiscalYear=fiscalYear) * fraction`
- `actual`  = `sum(Transaction.amount where transactionType='expense' AND status='verified' AND transactionDate IN [periodStart, periodEnd])`
- `variance` = `budget - actual`  (positive = under-budget)
- `utilizationPercent` = `round((actual / budget) * 100, 2)` (`0` when budget is `0`)

**Behaviour**
- `branchId` is **required**. Branch-scoped roles have it auto-injected.
- `period` defaults to `Q1`; `fiscalYear` defaults to current calendar year.
- Response is cached for 120 seconds per `(branchId, fiscalYear, period)`.

**Sample request**
```
GET /api/v1/dashboard/budget-vs-actuals?branchId=665f1a2b3c4d5e6f70890100&fiscalYear=2026&period=Q2
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, regional_pastor, branch_pastor, accountant, admin

with the email, code, and the invited user's first password. Requires specifying role and branch. Part of the
user onboarding flow — see also `POST /api/v1/users/{id}/resend-invite`.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, admin

role.description: Use the backend enum value. `pastor` is accepted as an invite alias for `branch_pastor`.

branchId.description: The branch to assign the user to

201.description: User invited successfully. Invitation email sent.

409.description: User with this email already exists.

get.description:
Returns a single user by ID with populated employee profile and branch details.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, admin

put.description:
Changes a user's role. Creates an audit log entry. Only super admins
and directors can modify roles. Part of the User Directory actions menu.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

Updates the user's branch assignment to the specified branch ID.
Creates an audit log entry. Part of the User Directory
actions menu.

branchId.description: The branch to assign the user to

post.description:
Generates a temporary password for the user and sends it via email.
The user must change their password on next login. Only super admins
and directors can perform this action. Part of the User Directory
actions menu.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

200.description: Password reset. Temporary password sent via email.

put.description:
Sets the user status to `deactivated` and revokes all active sessions.
The user can no longer log in. To reactivate, use
`PUT /api/v1/users/{id}/activate`. Creates an audit log entry.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

Sets the user status back to `active`, allowing them to log in again.
Should be used after a user was previously deactivated. Creates an
audit log entry.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director

Resends the invitation email to a user with `invited` status. Generates
a new email verification code and sends a frontend verification link.

**Allowed roles:** super_admin, director, admin

400.description: User is not in invited status.

tags.name: Asset Classes
tags.description:
Categorise fixed assets into classes (e.g. Vehicles, Equipment,
Property). Each class defines default depreciation settings applied
to assets created under it.

tags.name: Asset Sales Log
tags.description:
Track and approve/reject fixed asset sale workflows (from pending accountant request
to director approval and automated transaction postings).

tags.name: Assets
tags.description:
Track church fixed assets (equipment, vehicles, property). Assets
support depreciation calculations and disposal workflows.

tags.name: Audit Logs
tags.description: System audit trail — tracks all sensitive actions performed by users

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Authentication and account management

tags.name: Bank Accounts
tags.description: Manage church bank accounts

tags.name: Branches
tags.description: Manage church branches and their status

tags.name: Budget Allocations
tags.description:
Manage line-item allocations within a budget. Each allocation assigns a
portion of the budget to a specific chart of account. Related to
the Budgets API — create a budget first, then add allocations.

tags.name: Budget Templates
tags.description:
Reusable budget templates that branches can use as a starting point
when creating new budgets. Templates define standard line items and
default allocations.

tags.name: Budgets
tags.description:
Create and manage branch budgets with approval workflows.
Budgets flow through: draft → submitted → approved/rejected/revision.

tags.name: CashBoxes
tags.description: Petty cash / cash box operations

tags.name: Chart of Accounts
tags.description: Manage the chart of accounts (COA) hierarchy

tags.name: Compliance
tags.description:
Statutory deductions (PAYE, pension, NHF, NSITF) and compliance
summary. Deductions are created, tracked, and remitted through
this module. Use the compliance summary endpoint for an overview
of remittance status across all deduction types.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description:
Financial dashboard endpoints providing aggregated views of income,
expenses, budgets, and compliance. All endpoints accept optional
date range and branch filters.

tags.name: Exchange Rates
tags.description: Manage currency exchange rates for multi-currency transactions

tags.name: Expense Requisitions
tags.description:
Manage expense requisitions through a multi-step approval workflow.
**Flow:** Draft → Submit → Pastor Approval → Director Approval → Mark Paid.
Requisitions start in DRAFT status. Once submitted, they move through
PENDING_PASTOR → PENDING_DIRECTOR → APPROVED → PAID. At any approval
stage the approver can decline. If a requisition exceeds the budget,
a director or super admin can authorize an override.

tags.name: Logs
tags.description: System log endpoints (admin only)

tags.name: Maintenance Records
tags.description:
Track and manage maintenance activities for church assets.
**Flow:** Schedule → In Progress → Completed → Verified.
Maintenance records begin in SCHEDULED status when created. They can be
moved to COMPLETED via the complete endpoint, and then optionally
verified by a supervisor. Overdue alerts are generated for any
maintenance past its scheduled date that has not been completed or
cancelled. Related endpoints: Assets (`/api/v1/assets`), Branches
(`/api/v1/branches`).

tags.name: Permissions
tags.description: Role-based permission matrix management

tags.name: Regions
tags.description:
Manage organizational regions used to group branches/churches in the
finance module. Region responses expose frontend-friendly fields:
`regionId`, `regionName`, `regionDescription`, `regionLocation`, and
`status`.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Global configuration for budgets, statutory deductions, and asset policies

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description: Record and manage financial transactions (income, expenses, transfers)

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User directory management — invite, roles, branches, deactivation
